title: Billing Dispute Triage Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer reports duplicate charges, invoice mismatch, tax discrepancy, or chargeback-related suspension.
recommended_steps: Verify recent transactions and invoice state. Confirm whether the issue is duplicate billing, delayed processor sync, tax handling, or chargeback hold. Explain findings clearly and apply the matching billing policy. If the case involves a chargeback or unresolved ownership issue, route to billing risk review.
escalation_rules: Escalate urgent revenue-risk or chargeback cases to billing risk. Escalate processor sync anomalies affecting multiple accounts to finance systems support.

title: Refund Eligibility Review Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer requests a refund for renewal, add-on purchase, or suspected overcharge.
recommended_steps: Check purchase time, usage after purchase, refund window eligibility, and whether a duplicate transaction exists. Compare the request with refund policy conditions, then communicate either approval, denial, or review hold with a clear timeline.
escalation_rules: Escalate exceptions outside standard refund windows to billing operations. Escalate abusive or repeated refund patterns to billing risk when necessary.

title: Subscription Change Handling Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer wants to cancel, downgrade, upgrade, or reschedule a billing change.
recommended_steps: Confirm current plan, next renewal date, and whether the customer wants immediate cancellation or a scheduled change. Explain access timing, billing impact, and when the new plan takes effect. Confirm the change in writing after it is applied.
escalation_rules: Escalate contract-bound or sales-managed subscription changes to account management. Escalate renewal date mismatches to billing systems support.

title: Account Access Recovery Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer cannot log in because of password reset failure, expired verification link, MFA delivery failure, or lockout.
recommended_steps: Confirm ownership using approved checks. Identify whether the issue is reset token, lockout state, or verification delivery. Clear stale tokens or lock states where allowed, offer supported backup methods, and document the recovery path used.
escalation_rules: Escalate unresolved ownership verification to trust review. Escalate repeated authentication delivery failures to the authentication product team.

title: Account Security Incident Response Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer reports unauthorized profile changes, suspicious access, or unauthorized control of account settings.
recommended_steps: Protect the account immediately by suspending sensitive changes, initiating verification, and collecting a concise incident timeline. Restore access only after approved verification checks are completed. Communicate that the case is under security review if unauthorized access is likely.
escalation_rules: Escalate all suspected account takeover cases to trust and safety. Escalate confirmed broad-impact incidents to the security incident coordinator.

title: Failed Payment Troubleshooting Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer reports payment decline, failed renewal, or inability to complete checkout with a valid card.
recommended_steps: Check gateway decline reason, billing detail consistency, retry timing, and card status guidance available to support. Ask the customer to update incorrect billing details and retry when appropriate. If the gateway reason is unclear, record the attempt context for billing systems review.
escalation_rules: Escalate widespread gateway failures to billing systems support. Escalate repeated declines with fraud indicators to billing risk.

title: Technical Issue Incident Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer reports app malfunction, missing data, crashing interface, broken export, or integration failure.
recommended_steps: Reproduce or classify the issue, check for known incidents, gather environment details, and provide any approved workaround. If the issue is already linked to an engineering incident, attach the case and share the verified status update.
escalation_rules: Escalate high-impact production defects to engineering incident management. Escalate customer-visible data issues affecting reporting accuracy to data operations or analytics engineering.

title: High-Risk Escalation Communication Guide
trigger_conditions: Customer issue has urgent business impact, repeated failed resolution attempts, security implications, or executive visibility risk.
recommended_steps: Acknowledge urgency, summarize confirmed facts, avoid speculative commitments, and transfer ownership to the appropriate specialist queue with a concise handoff note. Keep the customer informed of the next checkpoint and responsible team.
escalation_rules: Escalate immediately when account security, chargeback risk, major reporting failures, or executive deadlines are involved.
